stored-goods.title: Goods our haulers store, sold into a standing bid or carried to one: one ship a route, only the pilot that stores the good, only while a book of the last hour shows the bid
stored-goods.note: Every route is gated by requires.stored and requires.bid: it opens for one pilot while its bid stands and closes by itself. It heads every hauler's list because a route behind standing work is never reached. Since 2026-11-17 08:00 UTC the hydrogen and soma routes are Trade's (admirals.log ENT-011, ENT-012: open to every division, floors kept by Trade): haulers store 2,257 hydrogen gas at Node Beta and Node Gamma and 98 soma; Logistics' own soma routes (floor 500) stood under every bid (344 to 353) and are out of the template.

craft-reserve.title: Steel plate made from the pilot's own stored iron where it lies
craft-reserve.note: Node Beta first (most iron); Central Nexus and Synchrony Hub where a pilot stores 300 iron there. Any role may fly these routes (requests.log ENT-190).

gather-reserve.title: Fallback: gather iron and copper ore into storage at Node Beta for the reserve when no hauling or crafting stands open
gather-reserve.note: Shared fields: their max_ships count across the fleet and Mining claims up to 58 places on the first two (admirals.log ENT-001). min_left closes a field. Not judged on pay.

gas-harvest.title: Gas for the haulers with a Gas Harvester I: one ship a cloud, sold at the bid the route names, the rest stored
gas-harvest.note: Each route takes one ship; a route that loses twice is closed by the dispatcher for its six-hour window and opens again by itself (F22). Needs a Gas Harvester I fitted. Since 2026-11-17 08:10 UTC only clouds that sell and store at our own stations (Node Beta, Node Gamma), where Trade's hydrogen routes take what the gas bid leaves (sell-hydrogen-at-node-beta 35,532 cr a ship-hour, 4 hours to 07:52 UTC); Antares and Deepwell haze sold at Nova Terra Central and left 666 hydrogen and 122 plasma stored there, out of reach. The Experiment haze, Coldwater and GSC-0016 are Trade's claim (admirals.log ENT-012).
